propositions: A standing, incremental per-criterion effectiveness recorder computes blocking-FP and detection proxies from sidecar re-review history alone, without outcome-corpus git-walks or LLM calls, and auto-includes any criterion ID present in the firing ledger.

The recorder reads persisted REVIEW_RESULT sidecars, parses envelope metadata (ts_ns and round_uuid) from filename, and appends one lean JSON row per (review-round, finding) to an append-only, prune-immune ledger keyed by (ticket, review_ts, round_uuid, norm_id) for idempotent deduplication.

The --report mode computes detection_proxy (fraction of blocking fix-units later remediated to PASS) and blocking_fp_proxy (fraction of blocking fix-units later dropped without PASS remediation) over a trailing window of tickets, reading the committed ledger deterministically without auto-recording.

The recorder is deterministic instrumentation with zero LLM/agent calls and is tested via synthetic fixtures validating detection/FP/windowing logic plus a non-triviality assertion over the committed metrics over existing corpus data.

Advisory criteria enter at advisory posture and are auto-monitored for promotion/demotion via this standing recorder without per-criterion wiring or registration; promotion-gate protocol is documented for R1/R3/R4 to reference.

The firing ledger is git-ignored (~8 MB, exceeds 500 KB new-file gate) and regenerable; the small computed metrics artifact criterion_effectiveness.json is the committed CI-visible baseline proof of non-triviality.
